description: Turn a config into a ready-to-embed three.ws assistant widget, a floating 3D avatar chatbot you can drop onto any website. Returns a paste-ready <script> tag (with only the non-default settings as data-* attributes), a standalone frame URL for <iframe> embedding, an equivalent ThreeAssistant.init({...}) JavaScript-API snippet, the visual builder link, and the fully-normalized config. Pure and offline: every field is validated and clamped locally, so a bad value falls back to a safe default and the generated HTML is always well-formed. Call list_assistant_options first to see every avatar, background, mode and attribute you can set.

accent.description: Accent "#hex" color for the widget UI. Default "#f97316". Non-hex values fall back to the default.

agent.description: A three.ws agent id to drive the assistant, as an alternative to picking an avatar directly.

avatar.description: Which avatar to show: a three.ws avatar id, a "/avatars/*.glb" path (e.g. "/avatars/selfie-girl.glb"), or a full GLB URL. Omit for the default mannequin.

background.description: Backdrop behind the avatar: "transparent" (default), a "#hex" color, a preset (ember, ocean, violet, forest, dusk, slate), or "gradient:#aabbcc,#112233,160". Anything else falls back to transparent.

badge.description: Show the small "three.ws" attribution badge. Defaults to on.

context.description: What the assistant should know about the site (used as its grounding context in chat).

greeting.description: Opening line the assistant shows on load.

name.description: Display name for the assistant / widget header.

position.description: Which corner the launcher sits in: "right" (default) or "left".

voice.description: Start with voice on (true) or off (false). Defaults to on.

name: build_assistant_widget
title: Build a paste-ready three.ws assistant widget embed
